$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor completion; Veritas does not read it.

packageManager.description: Package manager detected by `veritas init`, recorded for information; Veritas does not read it.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig file, relative to the project root, whose compiler options code analysis and test discovery use. With null, code analysis uses built-in options and test discovery reads tsconfig.json if there is one.

sources.description: Where specifications come from. Network sources are off by default.

local.description: Read specifications from documents in the repository.

github.description: Issues and pull requests on GitHub as specification sources.

enabled.description: Read issues and pull requests of the repository from GitHub. Uses the network when a run is not offline.

repo.description: GitHub repository to read, as owner/name.

enabled.description: Fetch web pages on the allowed domains. Uses the network when a run is not offline.

allowDomains.description: Domains web pages may be fetched from; no other domain is contacted.

maxPages.description: Most web pages fetched in one run.

maxDepth.description: How many links deep the crawl follows from a starting page.

maxChars.description: Characters of page text read in total; the crawl stops beyond it.

timeoutMs.description: Time allowed for one web page or GitHub request, in milliseconds.

maxDurationMs.description: Time allowed for the whole crawl, in milliseconds.

sendFullTextToLlm.description: Send whole source documents to the LLM instead of the relevant excerpts.

analysis.description: Which files are analyzed and how specifications are inferred.

include.description: Glob patterns of the source files to analyze.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files never analyzed.

testInclude.description: Glob patterns of the test files.

testFramework.description: Test runner of the project, which runs its tests, names their API and drives mutation testing. `veritas init` sets it from what it detects; without it, Vitest is assumed.

inferSpecsFromCode.description: Propose specifications inferred from code. They stay proposed until accepted.

requireApprovalForNormativeClaims.description: Specifications from documents need an explicit approval to become accepted.

backend.description: Mutation testing tool; only mutator (@mizchi/mutator) is supported.

mode.description: diff mutates only the code changed since the --since ref, or everything in scope without one; full mutates everything in scope.

timeoutMs.description: Time allowed for mutation testing, in milliseconds.

typecheck.description: auto lets mutator type-check mutants before running them and leave out those that do not compile; off starts mutants right after the baseline, but mutants the compiler would reject are run and counted too.

confirmDisconnected.description: After the mutation run, check the tests static analysis could not link to project code by running mutator again on their test files alone, mutating the project files they call into, within what is left of timeoutMs.

seed.description: Fixed random seed; unset uses a stable seed per property.

formal.description: Formal checks with Z3 and Lean.

integerDomain.description: Range integer inputs are checked over, as decimal strings.

maxSolverMs.description: Time allowed for one solver call, in milliseconds.

maxArrayLength.description: Longest array modelled in formal checks.

rejectUnsupportedSemantics.description: Code outside the supported formal subset is reported as unsupported.

llm.description: LLM provider used to read specifications. None by default.

provider.description: LLM that reads specifications; none uses no LLM. Sends text to the provider when a run is not offline.

model.description: Model name for the provider; unset uses its default.

maxTokensPerRun.description: Most LLM tokens one run may use.

allowCodexFileReads.description: Allow the codex provider, whose shell can read local files.

autoApply.description: Improvements are never applied without approval.

maxIterations.description: Most attempts an improvement may make.

maxPatchFiles.description: Most files one improvement may write.

reports.description: Report files written for each run.

formats.description: Report formats written for each run.

policy.description: How results decide the exit code.

confirmedViolation.description: What a confirmed specification violation does to the exit code.

inconclusiveBehavior.description: What inconclusive results do to the exit code.

maxNewSurvivors.description: Fail when more mutants than this survive; unset turns the check off.

minPropertyCoverage.description: Fail when a smaller share (0 to 1) of accepted properties has a meaningful test; unset turns the check off.

allowNetworkWithoutIsolation.description: Run project code even where its network access cannot be blocked.

retainRuns.description: Run directories kept; older ones are removed.

storePrompts.description: Prompts sent to an LLM are never stored.

enabled.description: Reuse solver, LLM and mutation results from earlier runs.

limits.description: Resource limits for the processes Veritas starts.

memoryMb.description: Memory limit for project code and Z3 processes, in MiB.

properties.description: Properties declared by hand. Each one is proposed until accepted with `veritas spec accept`, like a discovered one.

id.description: Stable name of the declaration. The property id is `D-<id>`, so approvals follow the declaration, not its position in the file.

kind.description: What the property states. `holds_for_all`: the target returns true for every input in the domain.

target.description: Function the property is about, as `<file relative to the project root>#<exported name>`. It must return a boolean and stay in the supported formal subset.

description.description: What the property means, in words, for reviewers and reports.

domain.description: Bounds of the inputs checked; parts left unset use the formal settings.

integer.description: Range integer inputs are checked over, as decimal strings; unset uses formal.integerDomain.

maxArrayLength.description: Longest array modelled; unset uses formal.maxArrayLength.
